listing.name: The Sims: Bustin' Out — Original Xbox (The Sims: Bustin' Out - Static Recompilation)
listing.summary: The project reports running a household in The Sims: Bustin’ Out on Linux using the North American original Xbox game. A Windows ZIP is published, but the guide does not confirm a working Windows build. Saving and physical controller use remain unconfirmed.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Check default.xbe from your own North American disc. The required file is 3,211,264 bytes with SHA-1 6feea04a12fb134253abe2b5662da634d0048232. Other revisions and regions need separate confirmation.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s Linux Vulkan and SDL3 setup to generate the game code locally. The guide lists no separate console BIOS requirement. You manage installation and version changes.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The Linux project reports experimental widescreen. The Windows guide describes a Direct3D 12 and XAudio2 route but says it has never been compiled. The published Windows ZIP has no confirmed play result.
